meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: The binding ultrawork-mode directive. This file IS the directive; read it only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already in the conversation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在需要时载入一份高强度工作模式指令,让任务按该模式约定的规则推进
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望 agent 切换到某个既定工作模式并按它的规则执行任务
copy.tagline_en: Load a high-intensity work-mode directive on demand so tasks follow that mode's rules
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want the agent to switch into a defined work mode and follow its rules

howto.what: 开启后 Claude 进入 ultrawork 模式:首行固定输出 ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!,用 create_goal 登记带验收标准的目标并写只增不改的笔记,交付需附真实运行证据。
howto.when: 当你要求开启 ultrawork 模式、且当前对话里还没有这份指令时触发;它会先声明模式开启,再登记目标并做 LIGHT/HEAVY 分级。

say.text: 开启 ultrawork 模式,帮我修这个 bug
say.note: 首行会输出 ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!

say.text: 用 ultrawork 模式给这个接口做端到端验证
say.note: 会登记目标并跑真实接口场景取证

say.text: 这个改动按 HEAVY 档来做
say.note: 会按 HEAVY 标准写 3 条以上验收标准

howto.what_en: Once on, Claude enters ultrawork mode: the first line is exactly ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!, it registers a binding goal via create_goal, keeps an append-only notepad, tracks steps via todo, and ships work backed by captured evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you request ultrawork mode and this directive isn't already in the conversation; it then declares the mode, registers the goal, and picks a LIGHT or HEAVY tier.

say_en.text: Enable ultrawork mode and fix this bug
say_en.note: First line becomes ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!

say_en.text: Use ultrawork mode to verify this endpoint end to end
say_en.note: Registers the goal and runs a real HTTP check

say_en.text: Run this change on the HEAVY tier
